acquisition method: operated in standard data-dependent acquisition mode controlled by Xcalibur version 4.0.27.19.
alkylation reagent: The free thiols were then alkylated with freshly prepared iodoacetamide (I1149, Sigma)
alkylation concentration: added to give 10 mM final concentration, for 30 min with shaking in the dark.
cleavage agent: Trypsin/Lys-C Mix (V5071, Promega, Madison, WI) was added to give a final concentration of 0.02 μg/μL
collision energy: with two collision energies toggled between 25 and 30%.
instrument: analyzed on-line by using a Q-Exactive Plus mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA)
labeling: The raw data were analyzed using PEAKS Studio X (version 10.0, Bioinformatics Solution Inc., Waterloo, ON, Canada, www.bioinfor.com) and Protein Metrics Byonic and Byologic (Protein Metrics Inc., Cupertino, CA, www.proteinmetrics.com).
reduction reagent: the disulfide bonds were reduced using TCEP, tris(2-carboxyethyl) phosphine (C4706, Sigma, St. Louis, MO)
reduction concentration: TCEP, tris(2-carboxyethyl) phosphine (C4706, Sigma, St. Louis, MO) at 5 mM total concentration for 30 min.
